Maya (CS): Quick synthesis from onboarding calls today 1: two repeating signals we should act on: per-route billing visibility and embedding latency causing search flakiness. @Liam (PM) @Arjun (Eng) any quick takes?

Jess (Onboarding): Confirmed in two pilots. One procurement team won't approve renewal without per-route cost mapping.

Sam (Account): Yeah, called it out in the renewal discussion yesterday. They want a sample invoice mapping routes -> dollars. If we can't show that, we risk the renewal.

Maya (CS): Snippets from customers:
```
"We need to see cost by route before we can run this in prod."
"Embedding latency makes search feel broken for end users."
"Procurement won't sign without a per-route breakdown."
```

feedback-bot: Signal captured: "embedding lag hurts search flow" (note id=8421).

Arjun (Eng): For embedding latency, we need to isolate model vs infra. Can we get a quick perf snapshot for the affected accounts (seq lengths, batch sizes, cache TTLs)? I suspect one has a low KV cache TTL.

Liam (PM): Proposed split: 1) short-term: create a one-page per-route billing explainer + sample invoice export; run quick embedding perf tests for flagged accounts. 2) long-term: console feature to show per-route usage & cost, and embedding latency dashboard / alerting.

Liam (PM): Ask list: @Sam please own comms to the two renewal-risk accounts with the sample invoice. @Jess please draft an AM enablement one-pager. @Arjun scope a 2-4 hour embedding perf surface and report. I'll put the billing visibility ticket into triage Weds.

Sam (Account): I'll draft the invoice mapping sample and attach the customer's invoice by EOD.

Jess (Onboarding): I'll prepare a 1-slide how-to and a checklist for AMs to share with customers.

Arjun (Eng): I'll run perf runs (2h) and share results. If it's KV TTL, I'll ship a config change fast.

Maya (CS): Added items to CS signal board: https://redwood.internal/cs-signals/1767987654. Marked per-route billing as P1 for the two at-risk renewals.

Liam (PM): Will update roadmap note after Sam shares invoice example.

Maya (CS): Thanks team 60; please update this thread with links to artifacts when ready. :sparkles:
